title: Eddie Johnson as a substitute with Desdunes and Olympia
summary: They talk about Eddie Johnson, who substituted with Desdunes and later stayed longest with the original Olympia band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You remember big head Eddie Johnson? I remember that.
You don't be getting there, you just wait for it.
I was at his house, we before that. He told me to tell you how long I saw him third. Really? Yeah.
Every time I see him he told me that. Yeah, that's my boy.
Did he work with you with Desmond? Yeah.
Did he work with Desmond? Yeah, he must have stayed a while with him. But he wasn't on our trip. No, he was not a regular man, a member of the band.
Yeah, he worked with us a while. Just for a few weeks there or something? Just substituted or something?
Substituted most last year. The longest band I know had to stay with was with Olympia, original Olympia, not all the past.
Oh yeah, he stayed with them for a while.
I mean Cuckoo and Big Ike, you know. He and I, two altos, Benny Benoit and Banjo. Oh yeah.
